_note: Bill Clinton's own words only, each checked verbatim against the page in 'checked_url' (the page the wording was matched on) on 2026-10-24.

_verification.method: Verbatim check on 2026-10-24: every source page was downloaded as raw HTML and each quote's text was string-matched against the page text, ignoring only quote-mark/dash typography; where only the punctuation at a clause boundary differs (the source sentence runs on), the words match and the note says so.
_verification.fields: per quote: verified, checked_url (page the wording was matched on), primary_source (when not the listed url), note, was (original text when corrected)
_verification.rule: Only quotes with verified=true may be used in game (tests/test_quotes_vv.gd).

quotes.text: There is nothing wrong with America that cannot be cured by what is right with America.
quotes.note: The Harvard Crimson page is OCR text with some word spaces missing ('isnothing', 'bywhat'); words match.

quotes.text: But, by the words we speak and the faces we show the world, we force the spring.
So today, we pledge that the era of deadlock and drift is over.
quotes.note: The Harvard Crimson page is OCR text with some word spaces missing ('deadlockand'); words match.

quotes.text: The era of big government is over.
quotes.source: State of the Union address, 23 Jan 1996 (as delivered)

quotes.text: But we can't go back to the era of fending for yourself.
quotes.source: State of the Union address, 23 Jan 1996 (as delivered)

quotes.text: I did not have sexual relations with that woman, Miss Lewinsky.
quotes.note: Words match the Speakola transcript, where the sentence runs on ("...that woman, Miss Lewinsky, I never told anybody to lie..."); the comma before the next clause is a period here.

quotes.text: I never told anybody to lie, not a single time, never.
It depends upon what the meaning of the word "is" is.

quotes.text: We simply cannot afford to give the reins of government to someone who will double down on trickle down.
